product.description: Hercule Poirot trebuie să descacirc;lcească ițele unui caz de crimă vechi de 16 ani. Atunci, Caroline Crale a fost condamnată la moarte pentru uciderea soțului său, excentricul artist Amyas, totul fiind considerat o crimă pasională. Acum insă, Lucy, fiica ramasă orfană, vrea să descopere ce s-a intacirc;mplat cu adevărat in ultimele clipe din viața părinților ei, convingacirc;ndu-l pe Poirot să-i dea o macirc;nă de ajutor. Și lucrurile sunt cu atacirc;t mai complicate cu cacirc;t există nu unul, ci, de fapt, cinci posibili criminali. Agatha Christie este cunoscută in intreaga lume drept bdquo;Regina Crimeildquo;. Hercule Poirot, cel mai celebru detectiv din romanele polițiste de la Sherlock Holmes, a fost creat pentru primul roman al Agathei Christie, Misterioasa afacere de la Styles. Poirot și Miss Marple au devenit faimoși la nivel mondial și au făcut subiectul multor filme realizate pentru marele și micul ecran.

## Unraveling Mystery: A Classic Agatha Christie Experience

Dive into a timeless whodunit with *The Five Little Pigs*. This captivating novel plunges readers into a decades-old mystery, masterfully crafted by one of literature's greatest crime writers.

Hercule Poirot is tasked with deciphering the intricate details of a murder case that occurred sixteen years prior. The victim was Caroline Crale, who was wrongly condemned to death for the brutal slaying of her eccentric artist husband, Amyas. Now, desperate and determined, Lucyâthe orphaned daughterâwants to uncover the truth behind her parents' final moments. She convinces Poirot to lend his renowned assistance. But as the investigation unfolds, the mystery deepens, revealing not one suspect, but five potential culprits, each with their own secrets.

This book is a perfect entry point into the world of classic detective fiction and Agatha Christieâs signature style.

### The Legacy of Agatha Christie and Hercule Poirot

Agatha Christie is rightfully known globally as "The Queen of Crime." Her skill for crafting compelling narratives and complex puzzles has captivated readers for generations. *The Five Little Pigs* features her most celebrated creations: the brilliant Belgian detective, Hercule Poirot, whose deductive reasoning remains unmatched, and Miss Marple, who together have become global literary icons dominating mystery novels, stage plays, and cinematic adaptations.

From Christie's debut novel, *The Mysterious Affair at Styles*, to the enduring partnership of Poirot and Miss Marple, her body of work continues to define the genre. If you are looking for a gripping read filled with suspense, misdirection, and clever puzzles, this book is essential reading for any mystery lover.

Yes, *The Five Little Pigs* is a complete and self-contained detective story by Agatha Christie.

**What makes Hercule Poirot special?**
Poirot is renowned for his meticulous observation skills and brilliant deductive reasoning, making him one of the most iconic detectives in literature.

While it features complex plotting, the narrative structure is highly engaging, making it perfect for both seasoned crime readers and newcomers to the genre.
